planets.name: Surixoch-Aresu
planets.features: Dust basins, bright volcanic ridges, scarlet haze
planets.appearance: Copper-red body with golden dust storms

planets.name: Mardukesh-Huitra
planets.features: Dense cloud ocean, green auroral bands
planets.appearance: Pearl-white clouds with green polar glows

planets.name: Aza'ra
planets.class: Flat circular life-bearing disc world sealed beneath the Veil
planets.features: Four major continents—Dakaroth, Arzuhan, Tzaphaer, and Belavadös—plus interior seas, mountain belts, floating islands fully trapped below the Veil, a heavy fractured outer rim, and a jagged conical underside tapering into a crystal spike. Nothing passes through the Veil.
planets.appearance: A vast flat ocean world beneath a luminous blue Veil dome, with four richly varied continents, mountain chains, cities and floating islands above the surface, a thick broken rocky rim, and a twisting obsidian-and-crystal underside split by orange-violet fractures into a long central spike.

planets.name: Enlimitra
planets.appearance: Pale green giant with silver rings

planets.name: Tlalokron-Shivae
planets.appearance: Stormy indigo world with white lightning belts

planets.name: Nannarvati-Apollatl
planets.appearance: Cream-colored world with blue storm chains

planets.name: Ishtarkali-Mictor
planets.appearance: Dark crimson ice giant with black polar caps

planets.name: Varunatl-Kronu
planets.appearance: Deep blue giant with broad white rings

planets.name: Ea-Narayotl
planets.appearance: Frost-gray world with turquoise auroral ovals

planets.name: Zeushamash-Indraxi
planets.appearance: Remote violet dwarf world with a bright icy cap

moons.name: Duvaen
moons.relationship: Sacred Morning Moon of the Triumvirate of Light; independently circles above and beneath Aza'ra
moons.distance: Veil-bound sacred path over and beneath the disc
moons.orbitCharacteristics: Continuous Veil-guided path above and below Aza'ra; rises for Ae, crosses the Belavadös path node, then descends beneath the disc
moons.appearance: Crimson-red, Mars-like moon casting warm diffuse light powered by the Veil
moons.notes: Duvaen (Doo-vay-en) governs Ae, Hours 1–7. Symbolism: renewal, ambition, vitality. Its light comes from the Veil, not the dead sun.

moons.name: W'iosamn
moons.relationship: Sacred Midday Moon of the Triumvirate of Light; independently circles above and beneath Aza'ra
moons.distance: Veil-bound sacred path over and beneath the disc
moons.orbitCharacteristics: Continuous Veil-guided elongated oval path above and below Aza'ra; it crosses the Belavadös path node during W’i and develops a slight localized zig-zag only near the deepest underside of its circuit.
moons.appearance: Vast pale-silver moon, larger and brighter than Earth’s Moon, with its radiance powered by the Veil
moons.notes: W’iosamn (wuh-ai-ee-shahmn) governs W’i, Hours 8–14. Symbolism: clarity, balance, order. Its light comes from the Veil, not the dead sun. Its orbit is distinctly oval rather than matching Duvaen’s track.
moons.diameter: Larger than Earth’s Moon; exact canon diameter not specified
moons.relativeDiameter: Display-scaled as a vast sacred moon

moons.name: Arvalla
moons.relationship: Sacred Night Moon of the Triumvirate of Light; independently circles above and beneath Aza'ra
moons.distance: Veil-bound sacred path over and beneath the disc
moons.orbitCharacteristics: Pronounced retrograde Veil-guided path above and below Aza'ra; it crosses the Belavadös path node in reverse motion, then sweeps on a wider, more strongly tilted and warped arc distinct from the other two moons.
moons.appearance: Massive blue-silver moon with permanent storms and multiple rings tilted 35°, glowing through power supplied by the Veil
moons.notes: Arvalla (Ar͡r-vah-lah) governs La, Hours 15–21. Symbolism: mystery, transformation, divine communion. Its light comes from the Veil, not the dead sun. Its sacred circuit is retrograde and intentionally does not follow the other moons’ orbital shape.
moons.diameter: Massive; exact canon diameter not specified
moons.relativeDiameter: Display-scaled as the largest sacred moon

nebulae.name: Âhufej — Minotaur Labyrinth of Anubaldir
nebulae.layers: Foreground soot lanes (900 ly), dense emission nursery (1,380 ly), red-brown rear cloud (5,800 ly)
nebulae.texture: Dense newborn stellar nursery with glowing hydrogen chambers. Rose tones arise from ionized hydrogen, gold from embedded young stars illuminating dust grains, while smoke-violet regions form where cooler molecular gas mingles with shadowed dust curtains. Texture resembles folded velvet mixed with branching smoke channels. Numerous protostars, Bok globules, and accretion knots are embedded throughout.

nebulae.name: Dus‘idu — Silkborn Web of Thoryn-Rahek
nebulae.layers: Silver strand foreground (1,100 ly), supernova shell (2,100 ly), violet mutation veil (6,200 ly)
nebulae.texture: Extremely filamentary remnant structure. Cyan and jade hues indicate oxygen-rich shock fronts while white regions mark compressed gas where multiple shock waves intersect. Texture appears as torn silk, braided tendrils, and lace-like membranes. Contains expanding ejecta sheets, ionized oxygen filaments, sulfur traces, and high-energy particle fronts.

nebulae.name: Ềdizfu — Dragonborn Dominion of Valkhamesh
nebulae.layers: Foreground sparks (1,800 ly), storm sheet (4,200 ly), primary rift flower (5,600 ly), violet dust rear layer (7,900 ly)
nebulae.texture: Vast petal-shaped dark nebula carved through a glowing emission field. Crimson and magenta petals surround blue-black voids where dense molecular dust blocks starlight. Texture resembles layered flower petals made of smoke and velvet. Contains cold molecular clouds, active collapse zones, dark filaments, and bright ionization ridges outlining the rift edges.

nebulae.name: Juçdimx — Crossroads Mask of Freyseth
nebulae.layers: Front ash layer (2,000 ly), reflective dust basin (3,400 ly), curse smoke (5,100 ly), under-road shadow (10,300 ly)
nebulae.texture: A highly reflective dust field illuminated by nearby blue stars. Silver and pearl regions arise from light scattering by fine silicate particles. Texture resembles polished frost, drifting fog banks, and layered mirror-glass sheets. Contains reflective silicate dust, carbonaceous smoke clouds, and fragmented molecular lanes.

nebulae.name: Jadd-Jisud — Wechselkind Crown of Setrimir
nebulae.layers: Metal-blue shell (2,200 ly), green shell (4,800 ly), primary red-amber shell cluster (8,900 ly), lost-key echo layer (9,600 ly)
nebulae.texture: Collection of overlapping planetary-nebula remnants. Amber and red shells arise from hydrogen and nitrogen emissions, while charcoal gaps reveal exhausted central cavities. Texture appears as stacked bubbles, fractured onion skins, and cracked glass spheres. Components include dying stellar cores, expanding gas shells, metallic ion clouds, and dusty ejecta rings.

nebulae.name: Horundar — Sahuagin Deep Gate of Bastveig
nebulae.layers: Tide mist (1,600 ly), reservoir core (1,900 ly), reef sheet (3,900 ly), blackwater wall (8,700 ly)
nebulae.texture: Diffuse cloud filled with icy cometary material. White and ice-blue coloration results from starlight reflecting from frozen dust and microscopic ice crystals. Texture resembles sea fog, frost plumes, and submerged currents. Rich in volatile compounds, comet embryos, crystalline ice grains, and reflective dust sheets.

nebulae.name: Wougen — Luma Mirror of Nephthysra
nebulae.layers: Blue foreground haze (1,200 ly), star-forming core (2,850 ly), mirror sheet (3,600 ly), rose backwash (6,300 ly)
nebulae.texture: Massive molecular cloud actively producing stellar clusters. Green-gold regions arise from mixed oxygen and dust reflection, cream tones from warm embedded stars. Texture resembles billowing cream-colored thunderheads crossed by turquoise rivers. Components include molecular hydrogen reservoirs, stellar nurseries, evaporating gas pillars, and young cluster cavities.

nebulae.name: Ŝiowoei — Dragonborn Dominion outer spiral
nebulae.layers: Silver foreground threads (2,000 ly), central spiral coil (4,200 ly), violet rear dust (7,900 ly)
nebulae.texture: A rotating spiral dust formation resembling a galactic whirlpool. Dark blue channels mark denser dust lanes while silver highlights indicate reflected starlight. Texture resembles braided ribbons, hurricane bands, and coiled smoke. Contains spiral molecular filaments, reflective silicates, and embedded star embryos tracing the coil arms.

regions.Description: Vast inner field of stone-rich and metal-rich celestial bodies.
Distant realm of frozen wanderers, minor worlds, and ancient debris.
Sparse outer frontier where isolated bodies travel immense orbital paths.
The furthest known limit of the star's influence.
The great celestial plane followed by the worlds.
Dense clusters of smaller wandering bodies.
Swarms of companion bodies sharing larger worlds' paths.
Reservoirs of long-period wanderers entering the inner system.

researchNotes: Asteroid belts are rendered as sparse, inclined debris rings rather than dense walls; this follows NASA descriptions of most known asteroids orbiting in a main belt with many small bodies and mostly stable heliocentric paths.
Nebulae are rendered as layered gas and dust fields, with reflection/emission/supernova-remnant behavior suggested through slow drift, filaments, glow, and parallax layers.
